text:
alex_m: Quick prelaunch check: final mini-freeze handshake for the EU midnight cutover. Anyone on call? Will hold freeze from 23:30-00:30 CET. Need pin approvals and rollback owners.
tara_pm: I can be on call until 00:15 CET, pd page and notes updated. Release notes link: https://redwood.internal/releases/rc-2026-03-20
jamie_eng: Can confirm canary is healthy in eu-central-1. 95p latency ~140ms. I'll monitor logs.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary-started rc-2026-03-20 on eu-central-1 (3/3 shards). status=green
priya_sre: Thanks — I've set SLO overrides for the 1 hour window. Priya -> rollback owner if we see error rate >3% for 5m.
release-coordinator: Quick checklist: pin v3.2.1 to the canary flag, set pin in deploybot: `deploybot pin rc-2026-03-20 --canary` — do we have approval?
alex_m: Approving pin. @tara_pm you signoff for release notes? :thumbsup:
tara_pm: Signed. :white_check_mark: small docs note about embedding costs added.
jamie_eng: If errors spike, plan A = rollback to v3.2.0, plan B = throttle traffic and revert heavy embed path. I'll prepare rollback script: ```./rollback.sh --to v3.2.0```
priya_sre: Added on-call rotation: Priya (now) -> Jamie (00:00-00:30) -> Ops-green if extended. Alert channels set to #oncall-safety and #eng-releases.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: pin-applied rc-2026-03-20 -> canary. webhook: https://deploy.redwood/hooks/abc123
release-coordinator: Last call for freeze exemptions. Only emergency hotfixes allowed; request via this thread with owner, risk, revert plan.
alex_m: One last smoke: run `curl -s https://eu.api.redwood.ai/health | jq .` — report status here.
jamie_eng: {"status":"ok","version":"rc-2026-03-20","latency_ms":120} — smoke good.
tara_pm: Going to set a 15min quiet hold at 23:45 to let monitoring settle. I'll post when we lift.
priya_sre: Noted. I'll keep extra retention on traces for 2h.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary-metrics spike alert suppressed (policy=launch-silence) — watch for true anomalies.
alex_m: Thanks team. If no major flags by 00:15 CET, proceed with rollout to reserved pool + notify customers. Document final decision here.
